# Step 61: 10½" wire from left strip lug 4 (S) to solder lug near filter cap

> *Connect one end of a 10 ½" wire to lug #4 of the left screw terminal strip. Connect the other end to the solder lug near filter capacitor.* — manual page 10

## What you're doing physically

A 10½" wire from lug 4 (BLACK common, the speaker's 0 Ω reference) of the left 4-screw terminal strip to the main ground lug near the filter cap. The terminal strip end is soldered (S); the ground lug end is NOT yet (more wires in step 63 and 64).

Lug 4 of the strip is now soldered final — it has the BLACK lead from step 12 + this wire.

## What this completes

The left speaker's "common" terminal is now tied to chassis ground at the star ground point. So when you connect a speaker to the left strip, the speaker's negative terminal is at chassis ground potential.

This is the speaker-side return path: speaker current flows out through whichever impedance tap is selected (4, 8, or 16 Ω) into the speaker's positive terminal, through the voice coil, out the speaker's negative terminal, back through this wire to chassis ground, around the chassis to the OPT secondary common (BLACK lead) — completing the loop.
